To one side near the tunnel wall,

stands watching the car, the red jacket catching only a thin edge of the distant sodium light. The driver's stance is still, one hand resting at his side, his attention fixed on the dark end of the lit tunnel. Nothing moves in the opening beat; the space holds its cold, cavernous stillness as the car waits in shadow, the driver a quiet counterweight at the edge of the frame.

pulls forward out of the dark, headlights snapping on and cutting two hard cones through the gloom. turns to follow the car with his eyes, one hand lifting slightly from his side, the red jacket shifting as his weight pivots. The vehicle closes the distance, its shape growing larger against the tunnel walls while pools of amber light slide across the body and the shadowed end falls behind it. The action changes from held stillness to forward motion as the car emerges into the lit roadway, the headlight beams widening across the concrete and the driver tracking its movement from the wall.
